lines.text: How did Jaffna's last Tamil king really die?
Jaffna, in the north of Sri Lanka, sixteen seventeen. A Tamil kingdom, ruled from Nallur.
Accounts say Cankili seized the throne, killing rival claimants and princes of royal blood.

lines.text: The Portuguese wanted Jaffna. Cankili called in soldiers from the Nayaks of Thanjavur.

lines.text: In sixteen nineteen, Phillippe de Oliveira marched on Nallur. The kingdom fell.

lines.text: Cankili fled by boat for South India. Accounts say the winds drove him back.

lines.text: He was captured with his family, and shipped to Goa.

lines.text: Some histories say he was hanged. Others say he was beheaded.

lines.text: Even the year is disputed. Sixteen nineteen, or sixteen twenty one?
The surviving royals, accounts say, were told to become monks and nuns. No heirs. The line ended.
